results.summary:
Added the built-in `codex` profile and everything around it, reusing the copilot harness mechanism from #32 rather than growing a second one. PR #34 (draft, `Closes #6`), branch `worktree-kb-6-1`, rebased on main at 2a76e24.

What a next worker needs to know:

- `codex` profile in `src/board.js` launches `codex exec -C {worktree} --sandbox workspace-write --output-schema .agents/skills/kanban/schema/terminal.json [--model M] "{prompt}"` — mode `process`, `workspace: "worktree"`, `heartbeat: "auto"`, `max_in_progress: 1`, `allowed_tools: null` (the sandbox is the whole permission policy; Codex has no per-command allowlist).
- New launch placeholder `{worktree}`: the absolute path of the checkout the dispatcher is about to create. `spawnWorker` now computes the worktree name before expanding the launch array, so `--dry-run` prints the real command without creating anything. Any future harness that wants its workdir as an argument uses this.
- `harnessFiles` in `src/init.js` is now a table (`HARNESS_FILES`) keyed by harness, with `HARNESS_PROFILE = { copilot: 'copilot-cli', codex: 'codex' }`. Copilot generation is byte-identical. Adding a harness = a `templates/<name>/` directory plus one entry there.
- `hkb init --harness codex` generates `.codex/hooks.json` (Stop → `hkb hook stop`) and `.codex/README.md` (the one-time trust steps and the `~/.codex/config.toml` notes, with the repo path filled in and TOML-escaped, no `[mcp_servers]` table).
- `hkb doctor`: `checkHarnesses` now covers every configured harness and takes its file list from the generator itself, so it cannot drift (it replaced the hardcoded copilot check); plus a new check that any profile passing `--output-schema <path>` actually has that file — a missing one is a hard failure because it breaks every attempt.
- `docs/harnesses.md` is the new per-harness page (profile table, launch placeholders, Codex trust/sandbox setup, troubleshooting, how to add a harness). README and `src/hook.js` point at it.

Important for the reviewer: I had no web access and no `codex` binary on this host, so four external Codex facts are documented-but-unverified, called out in the PR body and in the doc's Sources section — (1) the `.codex/hooks.json` shape and the `Stop` event name (`templates/codex/hooks.json`), (2) whether a Codex Stop hook honours `{"decision":"block"}`, (3) the `codex exec` flags (the launch array in `src/board.js`), (4) the trust and sandbox keys `/hooks`, `projects.*.trust_level`, `[sandbox_workspace_write] network_access` / `writable_roots` (`templates/codex/notes.md`, `docs/harnesses.md`). Each is isolated to one file and nothing in `src/` parses any of it.
